notes.ja: 攻撃を受けた時（確率）の味方全体の HP 回復は、被弾を扱わないので起きない（要件 5.2 節）。射撃場の 3 分モードでは的の攻撃で起きる（C-0551）
notes.en: The probabilistic HP restore on all allies when attacked does not occur because taking hits is not modeled (requirements 5.2). In the 3-minute range mode it does occur from the target's attacks

notes.ja: 自分の HP が 90% 以上の時の、味方全体の受けるHP回復量▲は、それ自体は与ダメージを変えない（HP を読む効果のある編成でだけ効く）
notes.en: The HP-recovery-received increase on all allies while own HP is 90% or more does not change damage by itself (it matters only with an effect reading HP in the team)

assumes.ja: 味方全体の 1 回の回復と、吸収回復（攻撃ダメージの X% 回復・5 秒）は、どちらも使った時に付き、そのフレームに 1 回だけ「回復効果が適用された時」を起こす（吸収回復は窓の中の命中では起こさない。C-0082）。満タンの味方にも付く。1 回の回復の回復量は、最大HP のみ▲・現在の HP▼ で下がった HP の割合を戻す分だけ効く（与えるHP回復量▲・受けるHP回復量▲は掛けない。plan/design-hp-heal-restore.md 2.2 節）（吸収回復は割合を戻さない）
assumes.en: The one-off heal and the lifesteal (X% of attack damage, 5 s) on all allies both land on use and trigger "when healed" once on that frame (the lifesteal does not on hits inside its window; C-0082). They also land on allies at full HP. For the one-off heal, the healed amount matters only by raising back an HP ratio lowered by max-HP-only ups or current HP downs (Outgoing/Incoming Healing ups are not applied; plan/design-hp-heal-restore.md 2.2) (the lifesteal does not raise the ratio)
